node.title: Re: detecting of scalar is string or numeric
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [vkhera],

So do I understand correctly that you want to tell the difference between 42 and "42"? That's nontrivial, see [id://1161427] and the links therein, especially the answers to [http://stackoverflow.com/questions/12686335/how-to-tell-apart-numeric-scalars-and-string-scalars-in-perl|this StackOverflow post]. There's also this thread: [id://791650], which includes a mention of the ^ trick you're using.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
